title.narrative: Flood Alert Emergency Assistance in Adamawa

description.narrative: ltpgtAccording to the NHF Reserve allocation of 2025 call paper, Nigeria is tackling a multifaceted humanitarian crisis driven by conflict and natural disasters. The 2025 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan (HNRP) underscores the severity of the challenges in the BAY states, where ongoing conflict and insecurity have displaced approximately 2.3 million individuals. The prolonged Boko Haram insurgency has severely disrupted agricultural livelihoods, destroyed critical infrastructure, and restricted access to essential services, intensifying protection needs across these states. Flooding is a recurring critical hazard that exacerbates the current humanitarian challenges.ltbrgtIn anticipation of possible flooding in the riverine areas of Adamawa State, Caritas Nigeria is targeting 1,538 HHs in Demsa and Numan LGAs with Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) full minimum expenditure basket (MEB) at $131.3 only per household. This align with the sector's recommendation and it will be a one-off payment.ltbrgtOur strategy includes, quick assessment of the affected areas to ascertain the number of persons affected so that they can be supported immediately.ltbrgtWe will carry out consultation with the authorities of the LGAs and the State in order to get a social register of the affected communities for informed program implementation. And also coordinate with other partners in the proposed LGAs to avoid duplication of efforts such as beneficiary targeting.lt/pgtltpgtBeneficiaries will be targeted and registered through the Kobocollect tool using Picture Enable Community Targeting (PECT).lt/pgtltpgtFinancial institutions will be contacted to help beneficiaries open proper accounts for the cash transfer as a means of financial inclusion which aligns with government's strategy on financial inclusion. The project communities will be sensitized and be informed about the program implementation, their entitlements, number of households to targeted and a committee will be formed in every community for program implementation. The Community Program Implementation Committee (CPICs) will include community leaders, youth leader, Women leaders,representatives of boys and girls, civilian security formations,persons with disabilities among others to foster inclusiveness in decision making. They will also serve as vanguards to help in proper project implementation. Volunteers, Enumerators and the CPICs will be trained on PSEAH, Safeguarding and will be made to sign our code of conduct. During targeting and registration, the social register from the LGAs/and or State will be requested from the right authorities to validate our registration processes. The final list will be provided to the communities for validation using our picture enable community target (PECT) strategy. Communities will identify the affected persons that are captured and confirm their authenticity and vulnerability status.During cash disbursement, the aged, persons with special needs and the most vulnerable ones will be attended to first in a dignified manner to avoid causing harm or their vulnerabilities. Staff, Community Mobilizers and Enumerators will be recruited in the localities to increase acceptance of the project in the localities.The communities will be informed formally about project closure and review the process of the implemented project, and lessons learnt will be documented for sharing with other implementing partners and to improve future programing.lt/pgtltpgtThe Communities will also be sensitized on early warning signs and system to help mitigate effect of future occurrence of natural disasters. A component of Disaster Risk Mitigation will be introduced to them during sensitization to help create good awareness.lt/pgtltpgtMonitoring of the project will be ongoing to ensure quality implementation.lt/pgt
